Mid-length, wavy, ash blonde hair with thick, side-swept bangs. Sharp, narrow, electric yellow eyes with a mischievous, energetic expression. Apparent age is a mid-adolescent with a spirited face. Slim, agile build. A dark gray and black tactical dress with a high collar and neon yellow accents. Signature details include a black beret tilted to the side and heavy, dark gray mechanical submarine rigging with protruding torpedo tubes.
BODY COLOR: fair ivory
